state.message: I lost my debit card on the train this morning. Please block it.

intent.instructions: Which team code fits what the customer in the message wants?

criteria.CRD: The card itself: lost, stolen, blocked, frozen, declined, damaged, a new or extra card, activation, PIN
criteria.DSP: A payment the customer wants reversed or questions: not made by them, charged twice or wrongly, a refund a shop owes
criteria.TRF: Sending or receiving money: transfers, payees, standing orders, account numbers, money that has not arrived
criteria.FEE: What the bank charges: fees, interest and charges, and why one was taken
criteria.ACC: Signing in and account settings: passwords, codes, app problems, personal details, opening or closing the account
criteria.OTH: Anything else: branches, opening hours, feedback, jobs, press, questions that are not about this customer's banking
